message: I stumbled upon my trusty fire blanket the other day while tidying up the kitchen. It’s funny how these simple things are often the most comforting, like a warm hug when you’re cooking up a storm. 🔥 It’s a little reminder that low-tech solutions can make a big difference in keeping things safe and sound at home.
